seo.title: Made to order, the privilege of a unique piece | Awrea Paris
seo.description: At Awrea Paris, each piece is made for you after you order, in your size, by French artisans. The steps, the making times and the tracking.

titre: The privilege of a unique piece.
chapeau: How your piece is made, how long it takes and when it reaches you.

parcours.intro: Each Awrea piece is made to order. Rather than producing in advance, we begin preparing your creation once your order has been placed. A more considered approach to making, where every detail receives the attention it deserves.

etapes.titre: The journey of a singular creation

frise.texte: You choose your design and its details. Every creation is born of your wishes and your sensibility.

image.alt: A black lace dress seen from behind, its lacing in the light

frise.texte: Materials, components and finishes are prepared with rigour, to bring to life a piece true to what you expect.

image.alt: Ivory lace and a pair of scissors on the atelier table

frise.texte: In our atelier, each piece is made with precision. Artisanal savoir-faire gradually reveals its shape.

image.alt: A seamstress’s hands working white fabric on the atelier table

frise.titre: Exacting, down to the last detail.
frise.texte: Every finish receives particular attention. Your creation is carefully checked before it leaves us.

image.alt: A needle held between two fingers, close to white fabric

frise.texte: Your piece is delicately placed in its AWREA PARIS case, then shipped with the greatest care, all the way to you.

image.alt: White bags bearing the Awrea Paris logo, ready to leave

delais.texte: The time shown on each piece is how long it takes to make. That is not the whole wait: your order is then prepared, dispatched and delivered.

confection.note: Each piece shows its own making time on its page.

expedition.texte: An order of several pieces ships all at once, when the last piece is ready. The moment it ships, an e-mail gives you the carrier’s tracking link.

liste.texte: Making to order, choosing desire over overproduction and giving each piece the time it needs.
Follow the progress of your order and find the essential information at every step.
